typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	toCatalystEtfTradeAlert1_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		current_par as string,
		total_cash as string,
		cusip as string,
		settle_date as string,
		super_product_type as string,
		inventory as string,
		trade_date as string,
		catalyst_trade_number as string,
		ext_counterparty_id as string,
		price as string,
		currency as string,
		captureDate as timestamp,
		buy_sell as string,
		isin as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> fromtblCatalystTrade
fromtblCatalystTrade sink(input(
		current_par as string,
		total_cash as string,
		cusip as string,
		settle_date as string,
		super_product_type as string,
		inventory as string,
		trade_date as string,
		catalyst_trade_number as string,
		ext_counterparty_id as string,
		price as string,
		currency as string,
		captureDate as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		buy_sell as string,
		isin as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		current_par,
		total_cash,
		cusip,
		settle_date,
		super_product_type,
		inventory,
		trade_date,
		catalyst_trade_number,
		ext_counterparty_id,
		price,
		currency,
		captureDate,
		buy_sell,
		isin),
	partitionFileNames:[($toCatalystEtfTradeAlert1_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> toCatalystEtfTradeAlert1
